question: What motivates the speaker to seek refuge in the protector named here?
premises: The speaker is afraid of the Kali age.
There is a protector worthy of refuge.
The speaker has gone to that protector for refuge.
inference: Fear of the Kali age motivates the speaker to take refuge in the protector.
plain_english: Afraid of the Kali age, I have gone for refuge to the one who gives refuge.
